description: This source file contains extension methods for configuring streaming capabilities on Orleans silo builders and client builders, including support for persistent streams and stream filters.

classes.name: SiloBuilderStreamingExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for configuring streaming in Orleans silos and clients.

methods.name: AddStreaming
methods.description: Adds streaming support to the silo builder.

methods.name: AddPersistentStreams
methods.description: Configures the silo to use persistent streams with specified provider name, adapter factory, and stream configuration.

methods.name: AddStreamFilter
methods.description: Adds a stream filter of type T with a specified name to the builder.
